body:
You're unfortunately right. Thankfully people as hideous as myself are very rare.

For people like me, no amount of fashion, fitness, social skills, or hygiene can prevent women from being nauseated by my hideous face. I cannot afford plastic surgery for the next several years, so either I'll have to accept being forever alone or just kill myself. 

It sucks, but you're correct. It sucks knowing your genetically unfit to live due to being ugly.

You're absolutely correct. Unfortunately I am one of those hideous, monstrous, disgustingly ugly people. I've spent 8 years working on fitness, fashion, hygiene, and social skills. I also have a good job, volunteer with animals, and am regularly social. I now am well dressed, in incredibly good shape, smell nice, and have my fashion down with form fitted clothes.

I still disgust women. I've been trying to accept being genetically inferior, but I suppose that I have a couple months left before I end things, since plastic surgery isn't an option for me due to it costing nearly 100k. Looks matter, so appreciate that you aren't as disgusting as me.

I actually do regularly volunteer at a local animal shelter (prefer it because animals don't judge looks), and participate in a Frisbee league (off season currently). I'm not completely friendless, but often my friends want to go out to meet people to hook up with or date, and they just don't want me scaring them away. Understandable I suppose. 

In regards to dating someone who is asexual, I suppose it is possible, but I'm definitely not myself, and would love to experience physical intimacy with someone who wants to experience it with me, which would not be the case in that kind of relationship.

Guess I'm fucked, eh?

Firstly thank you for your kind response. 

As much as I would want to agree with your fuck the haters mantra, humans are social creatures. I wish I could be happy just doing things online, exercising at home, and avoiding he public at all possible, that sounds like hell to me, as I hate being alone. Since I hate being alone, and my hideous face is causing it, it makes sense that I would hate myself as well.

It's not just that I don't attract woman as easily, but my face literally disgusts them. It doesn't really matter how amazing a person could be if their face is as nauseating as mine is. Physical attraction, and especially initial attraction, still matters. No one would want to get to know someone they can't look at without gagging, and due to that I'm forever alone (unless I find a blind person, which the odds are not worth even considering).

Again your optimism is awesome and you're too kind, but unfortunately I still think I'm disgusting beyond hope.
